text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Mihono Bourbon has conquered the 2,400 meters!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaahhh--!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: *Haa, fuu, haa*...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
......
Man~~... No good, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...*sniff* I couldn't reach her...!
Bourbon-san beat me, again...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice couldn't change...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That is not true.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
She had leveled up several notches since the Satsuki Sho.
Marking her on the track made that abundantly clear.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —I won't lose in the Kikuka Sho either.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Miss Bourbon...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The conversation between the two gets the crowd in the stands all fired up.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower has been chasing after Bourbon
this whole time, huh.
Both of them ran such an amazing race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka-sho is a long-distance race, right?! This is...
I can't wait to see Rice Shower in action!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Tokyo Racecourse, all eyes were completely captivated
by the 1st place Mihono Bourbon
and the unexpected rival, Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Matikanetannhauser—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aha~, silly me,
this time it felt like I was just so, so close.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
...I'm so frustrated!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser always gave it her all,
but for the once-in-a-lifetime Nippon Derby,
she was especially fired up.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: —Because I'm plain, I'm ordinary! There is completely, absolutely nothing special about me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Still, but even so... talking about the possibility of winning is another matter entirely.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Because even for me,
anything less than 1st place is completely useless!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...That said, things don't always end
the way you want them to.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's a race I'll never have the chance to win again.
So I was determined that I just had to take it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Even so, that's why, that's precisely why...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikane Tannhauser hung her head.
Her shoulders trembled, her fists clenched tightly――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The surrounding cameras zoomed in, as if
waiting for the tears to come, but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What's important is what comes next, what's next!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When she briskly raised her head,
she wore her usual cheerful expression.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There's always next time!
I'll learn from this and give it my absolute all!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, did you see Matikanetannhauser's press conference?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! You know, I lost my race today too,
so watching that really cheered me up.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"They told me, ‘Onto the next one, the next one!’ Hehe.
I want to be able to say things like that too."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Eep. That's so embarrassiiing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser's positive attitude and
cheerful words struck a chord with many people.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Kikuka Sho.
As always, I have no intention of losing.
